_the_rule: E12 Ruling 9d: an element whose surface a view cannot see is dropped from that view's stem - a term present in a view's prompt is an instruction to paint it, and the text wins against the control (the W3 beard mechanism, measured). Split deviation measured and ruled at E12 Ruling 10i.
_assertions: Each stem asserted an ordered SUBSEQUENCE of the entry's term list; each view with no drops asserted BYTE-EQUAL to the entry. Both enforced in the builder with no skip flag; a failure writes no file.
_supersedes: E12-pair-5 (d147a27). ONE TERM INSERTED (E12 Ruling 17e, on the Director's eye at the twin run): moss-green wing arms and finger struts enters the protective entry as its own noun phrase at index 2, immediately after the hide. Nothing else moved - no term substituted, removed or reordered, and the drop map is byte-identical - so every per-view term count is exactly one greater than v5 and the full-string view set is unchanged.
_wing_skeleton_term: E12 Ruling 17e. The Director's eye at the twin run: 'What's with the white bone on the back of the wings? It only shows up on 2 of the views.' Confirmed - views 0 and 4, the two WING-SPREAD presentations, painted the entire wing arm and finger skeleton bone-ivory against the membranes, while the folded-wing views kept the same structures green. MECHANISM: the wing arms and fingers were D1's surface BY FIXTURE ASSIGNMENT ONLY - no prompt term had ever named them. Their green on the folded views arrived from body context; on the wing-spread views the unclaimed bone-shaped structures took the ivory of  one-ivory curved horns (the Ruling 17c resemblance channel, next structure over) amplified by the bat-anatomy prior the realistic register carries. THE FOUNDING LAW MEASURED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS ON ONE VIEW: view 4's wing CLAWS are named and stayed charcoal while its arm bones were unnamed and went ivory. If a canon element is not named in the prompt it is arriving by accident and will leave the same way.
_split_provenance: E12 Ruling 9d default with the MEASURED deviation ruled at E12 Ruling 10i: views 3 and 5 hide the whole head behind the near wing membrane (head-box first-hit 0.81% of figure, and that is WING passing through the box's region of space, against 5.35-12.79% on the head-bearing views). Net: mouth family off {3,4,5}, horn family off {3,5}. UNCHANGED at v6 - the new wing term is in neither family and rides every view, because wings are visible from all eight yaws.
_palette_correction: E12 Ruling 12e, carried forward unchanged from v5. The fixture had named five of eleven elements in the pale-bone family and the literal word 'bone' rode this string FIVE times; under the ruled ultra-realistic register it rendered literally on BOTH measured seeds. D2 -> pale olive-tan, D6/D7 -> charcoal. 'bone' now appears twice and 'ivory' three times, all at the head.
_companion_stem: headclay_0 is the handoff-5 head-crop companion at yaw 0, frame 1360x1360, ortho_scale 0.223104. Element visibility was VERIFIED against its own clay render before the v4 stem was written; that verification is geometric and neither the palette correction nor this term disturbs it. KEEPS the new wing term - both wings enter the crop at the left and right edges. DROPS D6 (dorsal and TAIL spines, tail far out of frame) and D7 (feet out of frame). NOT SUBMITTED at handoff 9; the stem exists so the cloud guard's provenance check keeps working without a skip flag.
_companion_rationale_VOID: EXECUTOR FLAG carried from v5, still unrepaired and still the advisor's: v4's justification for dropping D6 from headclay_0 included 'the ivory family is already carried by D4/D5/D10', which is VOID under Ruling 12e - D6 is charcoal and no other term in that stem carries it, so the shoulder-end spines entering the companion's bottom edge have no declared colour. The out-of-frame clause stands on its own and is why the drop is built as dispatched.
_style_tail: ultra-realistic, menacing, sharp scale relief, harsh directional light - canon/DRAGON-IDENTITY.md STYLE-SUPPLIED as rewritten by E12 Ruling 10b and CONFIRMED by the Director at Ruling 11a. NO LoRA; lora-w 0.0 is not a weight of zero on a loaded card, it is no card, and the graph is built without the loader.
_backdrop: plain lavender-grey background - RULED, E12 Ruling 8a; premise corrected in place at Ruling 15i (a realised D3 stratum now occupies blue-violet) with the WORD standing, anchored by the accepted pair.
